create_dataframe_from_arrays: create a DataFrame by converting a list of 1D arrays into a BlockManager with specified columns and index
create_dataframe_from_dict: create a DataFrame by converting a dictionary of column data into a BlockManager with inferred or specified index and columns
create_dataframe_from_ndarray: create a DataFrame by converting a 2D ndarray or list-like input into a BlockManager with specified index and columns
create_dataframe_from_recarray: create a DataFrame from a numpy record array, extracting fields as columns with specified index and dtype
convert_object_array_columns: convert object-dtype column arrays into appropriate typed arrays using type inference and nullable dtype support
